items.source: Defaults to return the given RelationalPersistentProperty's name with the parts of a camel case name separated by '_';
items.translation: 默认返回给定RelationalPersistentProperty的名称，其中驼峰式名称的各部分用下划线"_"分隔；

items.source:
For a map valued reference A -> Map>X,B< this is the name of the column in the table for B holding the key of
the map.
items.translation: 对于值为映射的引用 A -> Map<X, B>，这是表中用于存储该映射键值的列名。

items.source: For a reference A -> B this is the name in the table for B which references A.
items.translation: 对于参考关系 A → B，这是表中代表 B 并引用 A 的名称。

items.source:
NOTE: Can also be used as an adapter. Create a lambda or an anonymous subclass and override any settings to implement
a different strategy on the fly.
items.translation: 注意：也可用作适配器。创建一个 Lambda 表达式或匿名子类，并覆盖任何设置以即时实现不同的策略。

items.source: The name of the table to be used for persisting entities having the type passed as an argument. The default implementation takes the type.getSimpleName() and separates camel case parts with '_'.
items.translation: 用于持久化作为参数传递的类型的实体所使用的表名。默认实现采用 `type.getSimpleName()`，并用下划线分隔驼峰式命名的各个部分。

items.source: The name of the table to be used for persisting entities having the type passed as an argument.
items.translation: 用于持久化作为参数传递的类型的实体所使用表的名称。

items.source: property - The property whose column name in the owner table is required
items.translation: property - 需要在所有者表中指定其列名的属性

items.source: a column name. Must not be null.
name of the key column. Must not be null.

items.source: Interface and default implementation of a naming strategy. Defaults to no schema, table name based on Class and column name based on RelationalPersistentProperty with name parts of both separated by '_'.
items.translation: 命名策略的接口及其默认实现。默认情况下，不使用模式（schema），表名基于Class，列名基于RelationalPersistentProperty，且表名与列名的各部分之间用下划线"_"分隔。
